sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 234008 (per-site catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Open annually mid-May through mid-September, weather dependent (recreation.gov sells walk-up sites to about October 1).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spring-hill-campground ('Open annually mid-May through mid-September, weather dependent.') + recreation.gov /rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-01), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Single site $15 per night; additional vehicle $5 per night (first 2 vehicles free). Double occupancy charged for more than one camping unit (trailer, RV) on a site. Cash or check only at the campground's fee station.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spring-hill-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234008 (notice 'Double occupancy will be charged for more than (1) camping unit in the site ... Extra vehicle charge $5 per day (first 2 vehicles are free) ... cash or check only at the campground'; /rates Peak Season 2026-2028 $15), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 9 sites are reservable and 6 are first-come, first-served. Reservations close 4 days before arrival; 3-night minimum on holiday weekends (recreation.gov rule). Reserved sites are held until 11 a.m. the day after arrival. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234008 ('9 sites are reservable and 6 sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping stay limit is 16 days'; rules reservationCutOff 4 day(s) prior to arrival, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 16) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spring-hill-campground ('Reservations available at rec.gov', '16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 15 camping units for tents and RVs. 'The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 22 feet.'

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spring-hill-campground ('15 camping units', 'The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 22 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/spring-hill-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234008 ('No dump station on site; closest facility is in Anaconda.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Pintler RD) campground ~11 mi W of Anaconda on Hwy 1, ~8 mi from Georgetown Lake, in lodgepole pine near Warm Springs Creek; day-use picnic area. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Pintler Ranger District; no concessionaire named). Confirmed $15, 15 sites (9 reservable on rec.gov, 6 FCFS), 22-ft max recommended trailer length, vault toilets + water. Added season mid-May to mid-Sep (no exact dates), 16-day limit, 3-night holiday minimum, 4-day cutoff, $5 extra vehicle, no dump. Hookups left (catalog: all non-electric; water/sewer not stated). Note trimmed.
